answer: Make the entry test proof of unique pet microchip registration with vet countersign. A vet countersigns the pet's microchip registration bound to the owner's identity. A farm needs one registered animal with one real vet record per copy, and a chip number on two accounts is an instant flag. Honest agents pass the mirror as a matter of course; a farm must buy the voyage for every sockpuppet it runs, so its lotus shrinks with each new copy until running more copies loses money.
